map.低度数选低折射率（色散小），高度数选高折射率（更薄），光学优先在高度数时跳过高色: Low powers choose a low index (less dispersion), high powers choose a high index (thinner), and optical priority skips the high-dispersion tiers (1.67/1.74) at high powers in favor of 1.70/1.71.
map.边缘厚度估算(负镜)：t_edge = ct + D²×|F| / (2000×:
Edge thickness estimation (minus lens): t_edge = ct + D²×|F| / (2000×(n−1)), where D is the diameter (mm) and F the power (D).
      The higher the Abbe number the lower the dispersion and the better the optical quality; the higher the refractive index the thinner the lens but the lower the Abbe number usually.
map.本工具估算结果仅供参考，实际镜片厚度受中心厚度、基弯、镜框形状等因素影响，请以验: The estimation results are for reference only; actual lens thickness is affected by center thickness, base curve, frame shape and other factors, so refer to the data from the fitting institution.
map.高折减薄但色散权衡。: High index reduces thickness but trades off dispersion.
map.选折射率看度数与架型。: Choose the refractive index by power and frame style.
map.−6.00D：1.50 边缘 8.0mm、1.60 约 7.0mm、1.74 约: −6.00D: 1.50 edge 8.0 mm, 1.60 about 7.0 mm, 1.74 about 5.8 mm; the higher the refractive index the thinner, reducing 12%-27%.
map.折射率升阿贝数常降（1.50 阿贝 58、1.74 约 33），高折彩边明显，中: As the refractive index rises the Abbe number usually drops (1.50 Abbe 58, 1.74 about 33); high index shows obvious color fringing, and mid-low powers choose 1.60 for balance.
map.折射率越高越贵？: Is a higher refractive index more expensive?
map.一般越高越贵且越薄，但色散增大；不是越高度越好，按度数选。: Generally the higher the more expensive and thinner, but dispersion increases; higher is not always better, choose by power.
map.色散倒数，越高色散越小、视物越锐；低阿贝片边缘可见彩边。: The reciprocal of dispersion; the higher it is the lower the dispersion and the sharper the vision; low-Abbe lenses show color fringes at the edge.
